Thanks for putting this together — it's clearly thorough, and a lot of it matches what I picture: saving links, editing and deleting them, tagging, favorites, the duplicate warning, searching and sorting, and it all working on my phone and laptop. That part reads right to me.

But reading it closely, a few things I really care about seem to be missing or not quite what I had in mind:

1. **Saving should do the heavy lifting for me.** When I paste a link, I don't just want it to guess a title — I want it to actually go grab the page's real title, its short description, the little site icon, and if possible a preview image, and fill those in for me automatically. I'd still want to be able to change any of that before or after saving. Right now it sounds like it only makes up a fallback title and deliberately doesn't reach out to the page, and that's not what I want.

2. **A "read it later" pile.** Separate from favorites, I want to flag links I haven't gotten to yet, and have a spot that shows me only those unread ones — and marking one as read takes it off that list. I don't see that here.

3. **Archiving, not just deleting.** Sometimes I'm done with a link but don't want to throw it away. I'd like to tuck it away so it's out of my main list and searches, but I can still go to an "archived" area and find it or bring it back. Delete should be the permanent one; archive should be the reversible one.

4. **Doing things to a bunch at once.** When I'm tidying up, I want to select several bookmarks and, say, tag them all, mark them read, archive them, or delete them in one go — including everything that matches whatever I'm currently filtered to.

5. **Smarter searching.** Beyond plain text, I'd like to search by tag directly (something like typing `#news`), combine terms with and/or/not, and search an exact phrase in quotes. And when I'm typing a tag onto a bookmark, it should suggest tags I already use.

6. **A longer note.** Besides the short description, I'd like a place to jot a fuller note on a bookmark with a bit of formatting, and see it nicely when I open the bookmark.

7. **Saving a search to reuse.** If I set up a search with certain tags included and excluded, I'd like to save that combination and jump back to it later.

One question on collections: the way you've written it, each bookmark sits in only one collection like a folder. I mostly think in tags, so I want to be sure tags stay the main way I organize and that a link can carry several. Collections on top of that are fine, but they shouldn't replace flexible tagging.

Could you fold these in and show me the updated version? A couple of things like importing/exporting from a browser I'm happy to leave for later, but the ones above matter to me for a first version.
